name.ja: 30MM 1/144 eEXM-17 アルト(陸戦仕様)[ブラウン]

description.ja: 30MMシリーズに局地戦用改装タイプ、アルト（陸戦仕様）が登場！
description.en: Alto (land battle specification), a modified type for local battles, is now available in the 30MM series!

description.ja: • タンク形態を好みの自分好みに組み替え可能。
description.en: • You can rearrange the tank form to your liking.

description.ja: • 陸戦用覆帯付きバックパック、マッシブレッグなどの新装備が付属。
description.en: • Comes with new equipment such as a backpack with a cover for land battles and massive legs.

description.ja: • 組み替え可能なバズーカも付属。
description.en: • A recombinable bazooka is also included.

description.ja: • 追加パーツはポルタノヴァにも装備可能。
description.en: • Additional parts can also be equipped on Portanova.

accessories.ja: 陸戦用バックパック/装甲×1式
